name: Speed controller P gain adaptation speed lower
note: Torque at the motor shaft per speed error at the motor shaft; p1461 scales it above the adaptation speed p1465 only

name: Speed controller integral time adaptation speed lower
note: Tn of Kp (1 + 1/(Tn s)); p1463 scales it above p1465 only

name: LR proportional gain
note: Kv [1/s] = 16.667 x p2538 (1000/60); the manual prints the unit [1000 rpm] and its p5275 example (5 ms PT1 = Kv 12 = 200 1/s) fixes the factor (page 1440); needs the function module position control

name: LR speed precontrol factor
note: Weight of the speed precontrol of the position controller (0 = off); needs the function module position control

name: LR speed precontrol symmetrizing filter PT1
note: PT1 that emulates the closed speed loop for the speed precontrol of the position controller; the dead time p2535 is not modelled; p1429 symmetrizes the speed setpoint of the speed controller for torque precontrol and is not this

name: Current controller integral-action time
note: Tn = L/R is the same in the simulator's winding and in the drive's

name: Actual speed smoothing time
note: PT1 on the actual speed; the simulator's filter is a first-order low pass of this time constant

name: Current setpoint filter 1 type
note: 2 = general 2nd order filter (1 is a PT2 low pass); filter 1 is switched on with bit 0 of p1656; filters 2 to 4 are p1662 to p1676

name: Current setpoint filter 1 denominator natural frequency
note: Notch centre

name: Current setpoint filter 1 numerator natural frequency
note: The same centre in numerator and denominator makes a bandstop filter

name: Current setpoint filter 1 denominator damping
note: D = bandwidth / (2 x centre) from the manual's f_3dB = 2 x D x f_notch (page 745); the simulator's bandwidth is the -3 dB width of a second order notch

name: Current setpoint filter 1 numerator damping
note: Numerator damping 0 suppresses the centre completely as the simulator's notch does (page 745)

name: CO: Torque limit upper/motoring
note: At the motor shaft; the drive's limit is constant where the simulator's falls with the torque-speed curve

name: CO: Torque limit lower/regenerative
note: The lower limit is negative

name: Maximum speed
note: 60/(2 pi) rpm per rad/s; p1083 and p1086 (210000 rpm as delivered) limit each direction further

name: Ramp-function generator ramp-down time
note: p1121 is the time from the maximum speed p1082 to standstill; the simulator's is from the rated speed: p1121 = ramp x p1082 / rated speed

name: OFF3 ramp-down time
note: As p1121: from the maximum speed p1082

name: Threshold for zero speed detection
note: Standstill is identified below it when braking with OFF1 or OFF3

name: Motor blocked speed threshold
note: With p2177 for F07900

name: Motor blocked delay time
note: With p2175 for F07900

name: LR standstill monitoring time
note: Needs the function module position control; the window p2542 is in length units and has no row
